description: Target repositories for Phase 3 (test implementation) and Phase 3.5 (review). Each target gives the agent the repo root, where files go, how to run the result, and - in conventionDocs - which of that repo's own documents define its conventions. Those documents are the source of truth; the stackDoc in docs/stacks/ only maps the layout and points at them. Copy this file to config/targets.json, then set each target's `root` to an absolute path on your machine. The real file is gitignored because those paths are local and org-specific.

ui-playwright.label: UI — Playwright (TypeScript)
ui-playwright.notes: TypeScript-native repo: specs, page objects, data and the api/utils layer are all .ts, imported without a file extension. The repo's own docs/ are the source of truth for conventions - the stackDoc only maps the layout and points at them.

api-mocha.label: API — Mocha + Chai + superagent (JavaScript, ESM)
api-mocha.notes: No WebdriverIO here. HTTP goes through utils/api-client.js only - never call superagent directly from a spec. The repo's own docs/ are the source of truth for conventions - the stackDoc only maps the layout and points at them.

example-legacy.label: Example of a stack being retired
example-legacy.notes: A `legacy-read-only` target is readable for reference but the implementer refuses to generate new tests for it — use this for a suite that is being ported away and deleted.
